statement: A nonzero smooth compactly supported profile cannot give an exact unforced periodic solution of the single-scale form u=lambda F(lambda(x-x0)), lambda'=a lambda^3 with a>0, support contained in one cell.
hypotheses: Smooth compact solenoidal F, fixed nu>0, exact momentum equation and smooth pressure, lambda scale as specified.
definitions: Leray projected momentum, stationary profile equation, curl profile equation, compact vorticity support.
source_locators: NS-B001 and NS-B002; classical analytic elliptic regularity for analytic semilinear elliptic systems (Morrey 1958, doi:10.2307/1970251); verify applicability to velocity-pressure elliptic system.
proof_or_gap: At a fixed time the rescaled profile satisfies stationary viscous elliptic equation with polynomial coefficients. Pressure solves Poisson equation with polynomial first-derivative source. Local analyticity via semilinear elliptic regularity implies velocity analytic, hence compact support forces zero. Harmonic pressure test additionally forces isotropic integrated velocity tensor.
implication_to_claim: Excludes the exact compact concentrating path of NS-B002 under full momentum dynamics, not arbitrary concentration with noncompact or evolving profile.
unproved_dependencies: A quantitative version of this exclusion controlling general evolving, noncompact concentration; full critical norm bound.
adversarial_findings: Analyticity is qualitative, no uniform quantitative rate. Pressure is not presumed compact until its gradient is seen to vanish on exterior. No claim that moment isotropy alone is sufficient.
